description: Global ordering advice and common mistakes for BAM ingestion

orderingRules.rule: Ingest top-level/backbone documents before detail sources
orderingRules.rationale: The sketch must have parent nodes before children can attach to them

orderingRules.rule: Establish the graph sketch structure before enriching with color data
orderingRules.rationale: Color attributes reference sketch nodes; nodes must exist first

orderingRules.rule: Ingest parent nodes before child nodes within each source
orderingRules.rationale: Child nodes reference parents via containment edges

orderingRules.rule: Ingest cross-reference and traceability sources after both endpoints exist
orderingRules.rationale: Edges connecting two nodes require both nodes to already be in the model

orderingRules.rule: Run model verification after completing each ingestion phase
orderingRules.rationale: Early detection of structural problems prevents cascading errors

orderingRules.rule: Create a model snapshot before any high-risk or bulk integration step
orderingRules.rationale: Enables rollback if integration corrupts the model

commonMistakes.mistake: Starting color ingestion before the sketch is complete
commonMistakes.consequence: Color data has no nodes to attach to; orphaned data
commonMistakes.fix: Complete the sketch design and backbone ingestion first

commonMistakes.mistake: Ingesting detail sources before their parent/container sources
commonMistakes.consequence: Missing parent nodes cause integration failures or dangling edges
commonMistakes.fix: Follow the hierarchical order rule; use the ingestion plan

commonMistakes.mistake: Ingesting too many items in a single batch without chunking
commonMistakes.consequence: Memory issues, hard-to-debug errors, impossible to rollback partial work
commonMistakes.fix: Use chunk guidance from pipeline stages; keep batches within recommended limits

commonMistakes.consequence: Inconsistencies accumulate silently and become hard to fix later
commonMistakes.fix: Always run verify after integrate/merge stages

commonMistakes.mistake: Not creating snapshots before bulk operations
commonMistakes.consequence: No rollback path if something goes wrong
commonMistakes.fix: Create a snapshot before every major integration step

commonMistakes.mistake: Ingesting traceability/coverage links before both endpoints exist
commonMistakes.consequence: Edges reference non-existent nodes; data loss or errors
commonMistakes.fix: Ingest cross-reference sources last, after all node sources are complete
